chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him)
When the men of Mu'awiya overpowered the men of Amīr al-mu'minīn (peace be upon him) on the bank of the Euphrates at Siffin and prevented them from the water

key_terms.شَرِيعةُ الْفُرَاتِ: The bank or shore of the River Euphrates
key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Siffin, a location in Syria where the battle took place
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةُ: Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad caliph and rival of Ali

ai.seo_question: What happened at the Euphrates during the Battle of Siffin according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha highlights the pivotal moment in the Battle of Siffin where Mu'awiya's forces strategically blocked the Euphrates riverbanks, denying Imam Ali's army access to water, a tactic that intensified the psychological and physical strain on the troops. This event is historically significant as it preceded the famous 'Arbain' (Forty) incident and the subsequent arbitration (Tahkim), illustrating the strategic complexities of the conflict between Ali and Mu'awiya. The narration underscores the practical realities of warfare and the leadership challenges faced by Imam Ali during this critical period of the early Islamic community.
